prior_outcomes_known: All phase3 and C3 refinement results through 2026-10-18, including the 128 tuning and 512 development-check bays.
hypothesis: An explicit constraint on completely missed free episodes of a chosen duration adds information not captured by two display-error durations or a total count of missed episodes/transitions.
same_training_data: original C3 256 BayIds from train_development Jan-Jun, 3 shared start phases
same_policy_family: C3 without_time, 12 effective state/observed-run groups, unchanged action grids, starts at fixed60, 2 coordinate sweeps
same_hyperparameters: lambda_F and lambda_O in [0.25,1,4], post-fit free cap in [75,90,120]
selection_data: original 128 development BayIds, 10 shared start phases
selection_each_ablation: training and tuning F/O no worse than fixed60; each arm obeys only its declared episode constraint; minimize measurements then F/O then numeric parameters. Missing episode metrics always reported for every arm.
new_check: 256 unreserved primary-validation BayIds, SHA256 order with masters-parking-duration-audit-v1:, excluding old128, old512 and all166 pilot-prefix BayIds
sensitivity: same frozen rules and BayIds, windows >=1 day, no retuning
analytical_fixtures: equal F/O and transition counts but different missed-duration profiles
exact additive interval accounting with end-inclusive miss boundary
finite replay zero misses is not a distribution-free no-miss guarantee
success_rule_for_mechanism: The protected arm has fewer M60 misses than both matched controls on the new check; report resource/error tradeoff and any failures. No claim that this alone proves global novelty.
